groups.title: Runnable account and profile slice
groups.outcome: A user can start the mandated stack, authenticate, and access an approved profile backed by in-memory SQLite.
entry_criteria: Q-001, Q-002, Q-005, Q-010, and Q-011 answered
exit_criteria: Startup and data-lifetime behavior are evidenced
startup_playwright_scenarios: Start backend and frontend; sign up or use approved seeded account; log in; view profile; verify invalid login
groups.conflict_risk: high: establishes shared project structure, auth contract, and database lifecycle
groups.rollback_considerations: Revert the slice as a unit; no durable production data migration is expected for an in-memory database.

groups.title: Role and administration boundary
groups.outcome: Approved recruit, manager, and admin boundaries are enforced, including manager oversight and admin user management.
exit_criteria: Every protected operation has allow/deny evidence
Assigned and unassigned manager scenarios pass
startup_playwright_scenarios: Log in as each role and verify only approved navigation and operations are available
groups.conflict_risk: high: changes shared auth and user-domain code
groups.rollback_considerations: Rollback with G-A-compatible authorization defaults; do not leave endpoints unprotected.

groups.title: Task and issue diary slice
groups.outcome: Authorized recruits can maintain tasks and use the approved issue lifecycle and filters.
entry_criteria: Task/issue API and validation contracts approved
exit_criteria: Approved issue lifecycle and filters pass
startup_playwright_scenarios: Create/edit/filter/delete a task; log and filter an issue; verify prohibited access
groups.conflict_risk: medium: shared diary navigation and API patterns
groups.rollback_considerations: Remove task/issue routes and UI together; in-memory records require no durable rollback.

groups.title: Feedback and notes diary slice
groups.outcome: Authorized recruits can submit feedback and capture tagged notes under approved lifecycle rules.
exit_criteria: Approved lifecycle and authorization scenarios pass
startup_playwright_scenarios: Submit each feedback type; add a tagged note; exercise approved lifecycle; verify prohibited access
groups.conflict_risk: medium: shared diary navigation; coordinate interfaces with G-C
groups.rollback_considerations: Remove feedback/note routes and UI together; no durable data migration.

groups.title: Scoped dashboard slice
groups.outcome: Authorized users see approved counts, recent entries, progress, and open-issue information.
exit_criteria: Seeded counts and ordering match expected values
startup_playwright_scenarios: Load populated and empty dashboards for approved roles and verify exact summaries
groups.conflict_risk: low: primarily reads established diary contracts
groups.rollback_considerations: Remove dashboard endpoint/page without changing diary writes.

groups.title: Authorized PDF/CSV reporting slice
groups.outcome: Authorized users generate content-correct date-range reports and download PDF or CSV artifacts.
exit_criteria: All content selections and date boundaries pass
PDF and CSV parse/content tests pass
startup_playwright_scenarios: As an authorized manager, generate each report selection for an assigned recruit in PDF and CSV; verify unassigned denial
groups.conflict_risk: medium: reads all diary domains and authorization
groups.rollback_considerations: Remove report endpoints/UI/generator together; no stored report artifacts are assumed.

groups.title: Responsive and failure-hardening slice
groups.outcome: All core flows meet approved responsive, validation, authorization-failure, and recovery behavior.
entry_criteria: Q-013 and remaining error-contract questions answered
exit_criteria: No sensitive data is exposed in errors or test logs
startup_playwright_scenarios: Run all core journeys at approved narrow and wide viewports, including validation, expired authorization, server failure, and retry states
groups.conflict_risk: high: cross-cutting changes may touch all UI/API features
groups.rollback_considerations: Rollback narrowly by affected shared component/error handler; retain security denials.

groups.title: Approved extension slice
groups.outcome: Two human-selected extension features are implemented and independently evaluated.
exit_criteria: Exactly two approved features meet their revised acceptance criteria
test_strategy: Feature-specific positive, negative, boundary, authorization, failure, and Playwright tests
startup_playwright_scenarios: To be defined without assumption after Q-012
groups.rollback_considerations: Each selected feature must identify its own reversible removal path before generation.
